summary.en: A pile of cards on a dark table is dealt into a page board with hard-accelerating cues while the camera chases the deal into a runway view of the full board.
summary.zh: 暗色桌面上的一摞实体卡，像发牌一样硬加速甩进页面网格；相机追着发牌升起后仰，落在整块满板的跑道式俯瞰上定格。

fits: The first impression of volume: a list page or card wall that fills up fast, "it keeps pouring in", in the climbing part of a film.
notFor: The opening shot of a film (it needs a lead-in); fewer than ten distinct cards; reading any one card; calm passages.

overlaps.note: cards land on a pile or stream past; deck-deal deals a pile out into a grid
a wall switching on in place; deck-deal is a wall that flies in
a standing wall in flow; deck-deal fills the wall once and holds

intent.en: Build the first impression of volume with suspense: a pile raises 'what is it?', then dozens of items fly into place faster and faster, so the viewer feels content pouring in.
intent.zh: 带着悬念建立“量很大”的第一印象：先是一摞牌（这是什么？），再是几十项越甩越快地飞进页面各就各位，观众感到东西源源不断涌进来。

content.en: 10 distinct card crops from the film (real page or item slices; 16 more are dealt from the same ten), a two-line title (en ≤ 26 chars, zh ≤ 10), a count label (en ≤ 22, zh ≤ 9) and the board's page title (en ≤ 14, zh ≤ 6).
content.zh: 10 张影片自己的卡面切图（真实页面或条目切片；另 16 张由这十张复用），两行标题（英文 ≤ 26 字符，中文 ≤ 10 字）、计数说明（英文 ≤ 22，中文 ≤ 9）、页面板标题（英文 ≤ 14，中文 ≤ 6）。

fits.zh: “量很大”的第一印象：一个很快被填满的列表页或卡片墙，“源源不断涌进来”，放在片子节奏爬升的段落。

notFor.zh: 全片第一镜（需要前面有铺垫）；少于十张不同的卡；要读某一张卡；安静的段落。

pairs.note: after the board fills, a standing wall in flow carries the volume on

en: Use real page or item slices for the cards; hand-made fake cards read as fake at once.
Keep the accelerating stagger; all cards flying at once reads as an explosion.
Compute the anticipation in pixels, not as a share of the move; at the far camera a textbook ratio is too small to see.
Do not open the film with it; it needs a lead-in to tell where the pile comes from.
zh: 卡面要用真实页面或条目切片；手搓的假卡一眼假。
保留错峰递加速；所有卡同时飞读作爆炸。
预备动作先按像素算再算比例；拉远机位下教科书比例的位移小到看不见。
别当全片第一镜；要有前戏交代牌堆从哪来。

upstream.name: 发牌飞入
upstream.summary: 暗色石墨桌面上的实体牌堆特写环绕开局，灯从牌堆亮到旁边的页面板，一摞卡像发牌一样硬加速甩进网格，相机追着发牌升起后仰、落在整块满板的跑道式俯瞰上定格
upstream.use: 展示"内容量大/源源不断汇入"的列表页与卡片墙；建立信息密度的第一印象
upstream.energy: 高（节奏爬升段主力，不放开场第一镜）
